metadata.methods_description: WIMAGINE wireless epidural ECoG implant (64 planar electrodes, 32 recorded from the left implant over M1/S1) with a 0.5-300 Hz analog band-pass and a 292.8 Hz FIR low-pass, sampled at about 585 Hz. The seated participant followed on-screen instructions to execute or imagine reaching and wrist-extension movements, with EMG monitoring of execution. The authors applied a zero-phase 5th-order Butterworth band-pass of 1-250 Hz.
